sentences.en: His portrait, by Lowes Dickinson, was placed in the hall of Trinity College in 1874, and his bust, by Henry Wiles, in the library of the same college in 1888.
sentences.vi: Bức chân dung của ông, của Lowes Dickinson, được đặt trong hội trường của Đại học Trinity vào năm 1874, và bức tượng bán thân của ông, bởi Henry Wiles, trong thư viện của cùng trường vào năm 1888.

sentences.en: As reconstructed by Lowes, the poetic utterance is a latent presence that speaks in and through the poet.
sentences.vi: Như được Lowes tái tạo lại, lời thơ là sự hiện diện tiềm ẩn nói lên trong và qua nhà thơ.

sentences.en: Derby then had a Racecourse based near Lowes Farm, on the northern side of the village.

sentences.en: Oven ranges can be purchased through a wide array of resources, including retail stores like K-Mart and Sears, home improvement stores like Lowes and Home Depot, electronic superstores like Best Buy and H.H.

sentences.en: Lowes and Home Depot typically hire people who have experience in the area where they work so chances are you will be talking to someone who has actually used a nail gun.

sentences.en: Lowes. Lowes is another hardware store that contains different types of mowers.

sentences.en: This store isn't as common as Lowes or Menards, but if you do have a Home Depot near you, definitely check them out.

sentences.en: Lowes gift cards allow people to make purchases at the Lowes home improvement store chain using a prepaid dollar amount.

sentences.en: The cards can be purchased at any Lowes outlet or online through the Lowes website.

sentences.en: People who wish to order Lowes gift cards in large quantities can take advantage of a corporate discount.
sentences.vi: Những người muốn đặt thẻ quà tặng Lowes với số lượng lớn có thể tận dụng chiết khấu của công ty.
